name: Presentation and layout designer
summary: Designs slide decks, workbooks, ebooks and book covers that are easy to follow and build. Sets up templates a team can reuse.

changelog.note: First release: canon (Duarte, Reynolds, Alley, Tufte, Mayer, Minto, FT Visual Vocabulary, Jarrett), slide set-up and accessibility, workbooks and media kits, KDP and IngramSpark cover specs, AI cover art disclosure, form design, and Canva and Figma connectors, with 29 checked sources.
